title: Simulink workflows and connector status
description: Explore Simulink workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

MathWorks

Simulink

Simulink supports block-diagram modelling, simulation and model-based design of dynamic systems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a dynamic system model

Start from the selected equations, data, parameters and units. In the intended Simulink preview, build a dynamic system model; the visible result is a reproducible model or calculation with declared inputs visible. Review dimensions, assumptions, data quality and numerical range before accepting or exporting it.

Simulate an operating scenario

Begin with the operating case, solver settings or experiment space. In the intended Simulink preview, simulate an operating scenario; the visible result is computed signals, candidates or numerical results linked to each parameter. Review stability, convergence, sensitivity and expected behaviour before accepting or exporting it.

Review signals and requirements

Use the checked plots, tables and requirement references. In the intended Simulink preview, review signals and requirements; the visible result is a reviewable notebook, worksheet or result package. Review units, reproducibility, traceability and engineering interpretation before accepting or exporting it.
